'''Lathe''' was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender|male]] who worked in the [[Jabba's criminal empire|criminal empire]] of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. A guard who worked in [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]], he was part of a group that traveled on a [[Bantha-II cargo skiff]] to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]] in order to watch the [[Death|execution]] of three of the Hutt's prisoners.

The [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]], one of the prisoners, managed to arm himself with a [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber|lightsaber]] and begun attacking his captors when they tried to push into the [[Mouth|maw]] of the sarlacc that dwelt in the pit. After Skywalker defeated all of the guards on the [[skiff]] he had been traveling on, he boarded the skiff carrying Lathe as the guards onboard began shooting at the Jedi. Skywalker then killed the guards on the second skiff, including Lathe, either with his [[lightsaber]] or by knocking them overboard to be eaten by the sarlacc.

==Biography==
Lathe was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender|male]] [[Slavery|slave]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> who worked in the [[Jabba's criminal empire|criminal empire]] of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and served as a guard in [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Jabba ordered that three of his prisoners—the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] and the [[smuggler]]s [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]]—be fed to the [[sarlacc]] in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]]. Two [[Bantha-II cargo skiff]]s and Jabba's [[sail barge]], ''[[Khetanna]]'', then traveled to the pit, with one [[skiff]] carrying the prisoners, and the other carrying a group of guards that included Lathe. Upon reaching the pit, the prisoners' skiff stopped above the sarlacc,<ref name="ROTJ" /> while the skiff carrying Lathe, which was piloted by the [[Skrilling]] [[Pote Snitkin]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> began joyriding around in circles over the [[desert]].<ref name="Beware">''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]''</ref>

From onboard his sail barge, Jabba gave the prisoners one last chance to beg for their lives. Solo and Chewbacca refused, and Skywalker threatened Jabba before being selected as the first to be executed. After being pushed off the plank above the sarlacc, Skywalker leapt back onto the skiff and [[Rescue of Han Solo|attacked]] the guards with his [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber|lightsaber]], which had been launched to him by his [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]]. Skywalker and his allies [[Death|dispatched]] all of the guards aboard the first skiff while Snitkin piloted his skiff closer. Lathe stood ready while other guards fired their [[blaster pistol]]s at Skywalker, prompting the Jedi to leap onto the second skiff and begin attacking Lathe and the others on board.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Stood around the middle of the skiff's deck, Lathe leveled his weapon at Skywalker as the Jedi knocked first<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Brock Starsher]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and then a [[human]] guard overboard.<ref name="ROTJ" /> The [[Nikto]] [[Yotts Oren]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> rushed passed Lathe, but was also sent flying into the sarlacc's maw by a blow from Skywalker, who then kicked at Lathe, causing the guard to reel back.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Lathe was then killed<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> as Skywalker defeated the remaining guards on board. Ultimately, the Jedi and his allies also killed Jabba and destroyed the sail barge before escaping.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Lathe had [[Color|red]] skin.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Equipment==
While on the skiff, Lathe wore a light blue [[Clothing|tunic]] over a white [[shirt]] with a gray [[pauldron]], brown pants, and a brown [[helmet]]. He used a black [[spear]]-like weapon to try and attack Skywalker.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You should have left the smuggler with us!|Dialogue  from one of several Nikto enemies with the Lathe model in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga''|<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Lathe_headgear_SW_Costumes.jpg|200px|thumb|Headgear worn by Lathe]]
Lathe first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> Lathe's helmet was made to cover up a seam in the back of the Nikto mask.<ref name="Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy">''[[Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref> In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was first identified in "[[The Battle of Hoth and the Second Death Star]]," an issue of the [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']] series published by [[De Agostini]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> on [[December 11]], [[2020]].<ref name="Altaya">{{Altaya|lang=fr|url=livres-bd/encyclopedie-star-wars|text=Official Star Wars Encyclopedia}}</ref> The issue erroneously describes him as being killed by [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> which is instead [[Vedain]]'s fate in the film.<ref name="ROTJ" />

The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity on a card in the [[2001]] ''[[Tatooine Limited]]'' set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]; however, the card incorrectly pictured<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Tatooine Limited|cardname=Lathe}}</ref> the Kajain'sa'Nikto [[Nysad]].<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> Lathe was then confirmed to be the Nikto wearing blue in the "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]]" feature of [[Star Wars Insider 143|''Star Wars Insider'' 143]] on [[July 23]], [[2013]].<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|143|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Jabba's Henchmen!}}</ref>

In the [[2022]] non-canon [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'', Lathe appears in the level "The Copa-Khetanna," initially being shown on the skiff carrying Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca to the sarlacc pit. The character's model then reappears as on of several generic repeated enemies on the deck of the ''Khetanna'' after the player defeats the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]], with one of the Lathe model enemies shouting at the player characters that they should have left Solo in captivity.<ref name="LEGO" />
